stem.en: Meera saved whatever was left at the end of each month. Her leftovers for six months were ₹200, ₹0, ₹150, ₹300, ₹100 and ₹250. How much had she saved in all by the end of the sixth month, in rupees?

explanation.en: The six leftovers add to ₹1,000. The bicycle costs ₹3,000, so Meera is ₹2,000 short even though she saved something in five of the six months. A plan that saves a fixed ₹500 first would have reached ₹3,000 on time.

hints.en: Add the six amounts, and remember that the ₹0 month adds nothing.
